Key upper-left-front #ffe9d0, rim back-right #9fe8ff, ambient #16233a. Controlled broad brush planes, coloured local-hue dark edges without black outlines.

A 2 by 2 grid with FOUR separated square panels, no lines/text. Native 2560x2560 requested. Each figure must fill 90% of its own panel height (minimal padding), never overlap panels. TOP LEFT: skill CAST, same bronze twin water-whip grips raised overhead, upright energetic lift, own whips only, NO discharged effect. TOP RIGHT: DOWNED kneeling collapsed, same outfit and grips, desaturated 40%. BOTTOM LEFT: ATTACK release toward screen RIGHT, one held water whip lashing +X, no emitted projectile/beam/slash trail, center torso. BOTTOM RIGHT: head-and-shoulders PORTRAIT same face wrap, hood, bronze clasp, dark charcoal vignette square. All faces and anatomy same as identity reference 1; other references style only. Crisp deliberate broad material planes, cool #9fe8ff back-right rim and warm key, lit teal folds, contour luminance >=0.30 against dark basalt. No ground, shadows, floating droplets or scene background; transparent except portrait dark vignette. Distinct readable poses.
